axes.reason: P10, 2.3 Render and 3.3 all render a quoted ayah from the book's page with Ayah linked and differences flagged. My condition holds everywhere I checked.
Minted ids, mention anchored in its parent span, re-anchor only on a unique verbatim match, lapse on a change to rendered text. Accurate.
Statement/Assertion split with Mention subjects and objects, and parsed/classified values. The vote and the reasons for rejecting each side are recorded accurately.
Link|Gap, 1:1 modeKey, abbreviations, derived jazm/tamrid, enclosedBy, riwayah and REPORTED_ANONYMOUS are all present. The author-voice origin needs fixing (see fidelity problems).
There is no Namaq-authored basis anywhere: P4, 2.6, 3.2 (abu Hasin stays text), 3.3 (Ibn Abbas unidentified). Condition met, apart from the 3.1 nasab basis wording.
Grouping a marfu' report requires a span basis; NAMAQ is labelled elsewhere. Matches my proposal.
Grade is a quoted span with a speaker; authorClaim is scoped; editor takhrij is spoken by the editor.
Revision includes rendered text and witness; only the owner publishes; review is separate. Accurate.
Per-Unit layout; isnad view only from reviewed identifications, never across a Gap; archive kept; ADR 0023.
Phases each have a rollback; Siyar comes first; the Bukhari go/no-go is measured.
Witness fidelity flags, Shamela only, numbering map, riwayah, and the mushaf/qira'a ADR.
Two distinct humans, one hadith-qualified; an agent is never a reviewer; the gate applies to the pilot.
Text is never hidden; our unreviewed judgments are never edges; the Prophetic exception is scoped in an ADR.

fidelity_problems.problem: The basis is sp_zb1, the mention's own parent span, with role SAME_WORK_EXPLICIT. 2.6 limits that role to a heading or يعني, so the example breaks the plan's own rule.
fidelity_problems.fix: Add an explicit NASAB role: a basis span covering the following nasab links (العوام بن خويلد بن أسد), distinct from the mention, or narrow the example.

fidelity_problems.problem: origin must be a MentionId, but al-Dhahabi is not named on v4/41. m_dhahabi has no span, so either it is an unanchored mention or the author is a default speaker.
fidelity_problems.fix: For AUTHOR voice, set origin = Work.author (Agent) justified by voiceBasis; restrict Mention to text that is printed.

fidelity_problems.problem: sp_zb_heading is used as a basis and as voiceBasis but is never defined, and it may overlap sp_zb1, which makes the heading its own basis.
fidelity_problems.fix: Define it as the entry-number-plus-heading span and state that a heading may basis its own subject only through SAME_WORK_EXPLICIT.

fidelity_problems.problem: An author with no transcribed mention (al-Dhahabi) renders 'not yet named' in Arabic UI, yet the attribution line names him.
fidelity_problems.fix: Allow displayMention from the Work's title-page span, or state that attribution labels use Gloss or a work-title span.

fidelity_problems.problem: 'when an image is available' lets a matn pass P9 with no print check, while Shamela is unchecked against print.
fidelity_problems.fix: Record 'no image' explicitly on the review, and show the matn with an 'unchecked against print' mark.

fidelity_problems.problem: 'never copied from a book' could be read as forbidding book quotations of ayat, which P10 displays.
fidelity_problems.fix: Reword: Qur'an views use Ayah only; a book's quotation is shown as that book's text.
